g.text: Terms: AI = artificial intelligence (here, an AI assistant drafting at independence level I0) · ARP4754B = SAE guidelines for development of civil aircraft and systems · ARP4761A = SAE
guidelines for the safety assessment process on civil aircraft · CAD = computer-aided design · CE = Chief Engineer (simulated role ROLE-CE) · CL-nnn = concept layout (cad/params/CL-nn.yaml;
CL-01 to CL-05, CL-05 the reference layout) · CoM = centre of mass · CONOPS = concept of operations · DoD = US Department of Defense · DQ-nnn = decision question for the project lead
(decisions/register.yaml) · EC-nnn = edge case found by a failure search · EVT-nnn = test or demonstration event record (safety/events/) · FHA = functional hazard analysis (MIL-STD-882E Task
208; also ARP4761A aircraft FHA) · G0–G7 = lifecycle gate (G0 concept to G7 change and sustainment) · I0–I3 = review independence level (I0 none, e.g. the author or an AI, to I3 independent
organisation) · ID = identifier · MIL-STD-882E = US DoD Standard Practice for System Safety (11 May 2012, base edition) · MuJoCo = Multi-Joint dynamics with Contact, the physics engine for
the level-2 walker model · PDaC = Product Development as Code · PE = Program Executive (simulated role ROLE-PE) · PL = Program Lead (simulated role ROLE-PL) · ROLE-nnn = project role in the
tailoring record (simulated until the lead says otherwise) · SAE = SAE International, publisher of ARP4754B and ARP4761A · SHA = system hazard analysis (MIL-STD-882E Task 205) · SUS-M1-MAN =
manipulation arms and end effectors · TS-nnn = architecture trade study · UAV = uncrewed aerial vehicle (drone) · US = United States
